messages:
emily: FYI — customer ACME reported a spiky 500 series yesterday tied to a KMS permission error. They asked if any retained audit data could include PII. Need scope + timeline for notification.

raj: Thanks, Emily. Can you paste the error snippet? Also did the request hit hosted or dedicated?

emily: Hosted API. Error from their logs: `KMSAccessDenied: decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-efgh`

mike: Added to incident tracker (INC-2026). Customer is pushing for an ETA on whether exports include payload. They said they saw 10k affected requests between 2026-03-10 03:00-03:20 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 by mike. Pager duty notified.

raj: Quick notes — our standard telemetry pipeline scrubs request bodies for hosted endpoints except where customers opt into full request logging. We need to confirm if ACME had full-logging enabled. Emily, can you confirm their org settings?

emily: They opted into verbose logs for debugging last month. I can see an org flag `debug_request_logging: true` in their tenant config.

raj: That explains potential exposure in logs. Next steps: 1) confirm which stores received unredacted payloads (ingest logs, audit exports, ephemeral debug buckets). 2) Pull a sample set and run a PII check. 3) Draft customer notification if PII present.

sara: For timeline: I can run the storage grep + list in ~3 hours if we get access approved. Need a formal auth/approval from Legal for reading customer payloads.

legal-ops: Confirmed — Legal approves scoped access to ingest/log buckets for triage. Please keep sampling minimal and do not persist copies outside secure staging. Tag with `INC-2026` in all notes.

raj: Command I'll run (read-only):
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-logs-prod --prefix "acme/org-789/2026-03-10/"
aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-logs-prod --key "acme/org-789/2026-03-10/03_05_12.log" /tmp/sample.log
```
I'll pipe sample.log through our PII detector.

mike: Can we also verify KMS key access logs? If the decrypt attempted failed, the key usage might show a deny event that helps explain the window. Raj can you pull CloudTrail KMS events for that key?

raj: Yes — pulling CloudTrail KMS events now for key `abcd-efgh` between 2026-03-10T02:50:00Z and 2026-03-10T03:30:00Z.

emily: Quick customer comms draft suggestion: "We're investigating an intermittent KMS auth failure that may have affected debug logs you enabled. We're confirming whether any logs contained sensitive info and will follow up within 48 hours with findings." Thoughts?

legal-ops: That reads fine. Add: we are not aware of any exfiltration; this is an internal audit. Include remediation steps and offer log redaction support if needed.

sara: Update: I started the grep job — found 12 debug log files in the window. Pulling first sample now.

raj: CloudTrail shows three `KMS:Decrypt` failures from our service role due to a recently rotated key policy change — rotation happened 2026-03-09 23:00 UTC. That aligns with a retry storm on the client side which produced extra debug logs.

emily: Ok. If rotation caused the temporary deny, then the incident scope is likely limited to debug logs created during retries. Still need the PII check result.

sara: PII detector run: 2 of 12 files flagged email addresses and short name fields — nothing like SSNs or payment tokens. I'll redact and summarize findings.

mike: Good. Action items: (1) Raj to document KMS policy change timeline and rollback plan if needed; (2) Sara to produce sanitized summary for customer; (3) Emily to send timeline + draft comms. Target: customer update within 6 hours.

raj: Documented timeline + CloudTrail extract attached to INC-2026 (internal link). No signs of external access.

emily: Sending customer draft now. I'll mark as `CONFIDENTIAL` and include offer for redaction assistance.

legal-ops: Please cc compliance@redwood on the outbound. Keep copies in secure folder.

mike: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If anything changes where we need to expand notification, escalate to execs immediately. :thumbsup:
